description: A complete formula whose free-variable set is empty can be regarded as a sentence without free-variable names.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSyntax.sentenceOfNoFreeVar.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'}
  [DecidableEq α] (φ : L.Formula α) (h : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.freeVarFinset φ = ∅) : L.Sentence
